body_markdown:
Last week, Spotify turned up the volume in Seoul once again. From September 10 through 13, Spotify House Seoul returned to Anderson C in Seongsu for its biggest edition yet.


Set in one of Seoul’s most vibrant creative venues, this year’s Spotify House was a four-day celebration packed with live performances and expanded daytime programming to bring the best of Spotify and Korean music to life, both onstage and beyond.


## **Inside the lineup**


Spotify House Seoul kicked off with a night celebrating the growing connection between electronic music and K-Pop. Artist, producer, and DJ


[Diplo](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5fMUXHkw8R8eOP2RNVYEZX?si=i8oVmHMMTha8onE2BBlp5w) led the lineup alongside


[RIIZE](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2jOm3cYujQx6o1dxuiuqaX?si=4w_B_2ZbTAO7qGsvu30CfA) , the first K-Pop boy group


[selected as a Spotify RADAR Korea artist](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2024-06-26/radar-korea-invites-fans-inside-the-vibrant-world-of-riize-in-honor-of-the-k-pop-groups-first-mini-album-riizing/) , plus


[RESCENE](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5deOsjuFTKrNMJW3rKuL8S?si=2QwPoQOFQzOYsOx5SBRDLA) and


[Yves](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6AkddQqEu75QRbsCo12zce?si=a9vFxZJZTQeuq9o4l7_0Eg) .


“Spotify has been part of my journey for a long time, and I’ve always loved how it helps music travel, reaching new listeners and connecting people,” said


**Diplo** . “Getting to bring that relationship into the real world at Spotify House Seoul and share that energy with fans here made this one really special.”

[HYUKOH](https://open.spotify.com/artist/57okaLdCtv3nVBSn5otJkp?si=Kx-tGuhLQnOiUcYs1DL7Jg) ,


[Silica Gel](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2kxVxKOgoefmgkwoHipHsn?si=p-KFH2y7RDO86FTtN7XNkQ) , and


[KARDI](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6v8xPUDPu5hQlu0GrYHyOE?si=THLoA_OvR_qoFgce8FSOBQ) joined RADAR Korea artist


[can’t be blue](https://open.spotify.com/artist/32mluwkanSuuM3hm3d3Fh5?si=2aV0rQMgTd-WDqSfKpXBFw) for a night that brought together established favorites and emerging talent.

## **A House built for fans**


While the nights were built around performance, the daytime program took fans behind the curtain. Anderson C transformed into a space to experience Spotify beyond the app, with immersive installations and interactive experiences that explored the stories and communities behind today’s music.


Fans participated in activities like a dance masterclass with choreographer


**Honey J** , while Spotify House-exclusive collaborations and surprise experiences offered even more ways to discover new artists and connect with fellow listeners.


The event wrapped up with a final day dedicated to exploring Spotify House beyond the performances.


“This year, Spotify House Seoul was about creating more ways for fans to spend meaningful time with the music and artists they love,” said


**Gautam Talwar** , General Manager, Spotify APAC. “The energy we saw throughout the four days showed how music can bring people together in so many different ways, and we’ll continue creating experiences that deepen those connections between artists and fans.”
